title: add RAG agent templates, tool-calling samples, and docs quickstarts
author: Maya Patel
description:
Motivation: provide opinionated RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates and small tool-calling examples to accelerate developer onboarding and make the docs quickstarts runnable with the Redwood SDKs. This PR adds template prompts, example agent implementations (Python + TypeScript), tool-calling HTTP and DB connector samples, and updates the docs site quickstart pages.

What changed (high level): added a new docs quickstart (docs/quickstarts/rag-agent-templates.md), three runnable examples under redwood-examples/rag (python-agent, ts-agent, http-tool), integrated minimal sample datasets and Dockerfile for local testing, and added a small eval harness to smoke-test end-to-end tool calls in CI.

Checklist: [x] RAG templates (prompt + config); [x] Python agent example with tool-calling (http and sqlite); [x] TypeScript agent example with tool-calling; [x] Docs site quickstart with copyable snippets and config; [x] Unit tests for example helpers; [x] Minimal CI smoke test added; [x] Reviewed and approved by reviewers.

Usage notes: all examples default to the hosted API key from REDWOOD_API_KEY env var; examples include local sqlite dataset and a small HTTP weather tool stub for demonstration. Developers should follow the docs quickstart to provision a temporary index and run the agent locally. The quickstart includes guidance on batching, caching, and model pinning to match production behavior.

Backwards compatibility: no runtime or API changes to the serving runtime or SDKs; docs/examples only.

Related: ENG-3491 (RAG templates backlog), DOC-712 (docs quickstart epic), SUP-3241 (support ticket referencing missing examples).
